ids a reviewer actually read are what the apply must be bound to.

rail's own computation and independently of the stored espn_id: once by the deriving
pass (scoreboard over 36 ET dates / 481 games, plus summary on all 40 ids named), and
again by the attending operator before this file was written (summary on all 17
targets). The second pass asserted, per row: the true game's start equals our

table was built. Result: 17 AGREE, 0 REJECT.

whose espn_id and score are internally consistent with the OTHER game of the pair, so
commence_time may be the drifted field instead; one (15185681) has both a drifted id
and a commence_time 240 minutes off, with a stored score matching no game within
three days. A target that is not proven is not written — that is the rule this
population exists to honour, not an omission from it.
